determinism.layout: fixed ASCII directory and lowercase SHA-256 filenames derived only from content identities; no session name, user string, clock or random value names committed state
determinism.listing: visible run identities are full lowercase digests sorted lexically after fresh validation, independent of directory enumeration order
determinism.record: strict duplicate-rejecting compact sorted ASCII JSON with one LF, NFC strings, bounded integers, sorted unique object digest inventory and self hash
determinism.relocation: copying exact supported store bytes to another valid root preserves every canonical identity and load result
determinism.result: identical root state and bundle bytes produce the same semantic result identity; stored versus existing is the only effect-state distinction

effects.cache: physical exact-byte deduplication only; no semantic outcome reuse or lookup is authorized
effects.clock: none for canonical data, identity, ordering or correctness; filesystem timestamps are ignored
effects.filesystem: bounded create, lstat/open/read/write/fsync/replace and directory enumeration only beneath the explicit root; immutable content and run records are append-only and no committed material is deleted
effects.memory: bounded bundle replay, canonical record construction, streaming or bounded exact file verification, and immutable result construction
effects.mutation: caller bundle is not mutated; new immutable files may be appended beneath root
effects.persistence: content-addressed objects plus one immutable content-addressed run record installed last

ensures: The function freshly replays the exact bundle before writing and returns stored or existing only for a complete replay with exact manifest, logical report and object closure; invalid bundles produce a closed non-authoritative invalid result without a visible run reference.

Only v2 bundles whose worker-observation closure passes fresh replay are eligible for persistence; v1 records remain historical migration inputs and cannot be reinterpreted as v2 stored or loaded success.

Content bytes are written to immutable SHA-256-addressed regular files, exact existing bytes dedupe, conflicting or corrupted existing bytes fail, and manifest plus logical report are ordinary content objects bound by the run record.

The immutable run record is the sole commit point and is installed last only after every referenced object is durably written where supported; an interrupted operation may leave unreachable objects but never a visible partial or falsely complete run.

Store roots and components are created with private permissions where supported and every existing ancestor, store directory, content file and run record is checked without following symlinks or reparse points; hardlinked content and run records are rejected.

A same-run concurrent writer converges only on byte-identical immutable state; different runs remain independent; no operation overwrites, truncates, repairs, renames over or deletes a committed different byte string.

Public load and digest-sorted listing helpers governed by this contract read exact immutable records and objects, freshly replay each visible run before returning it, reject any corruption or unsupported filesystem state, and ignore unreachable orphan objects as noncommitted.

Store and temporary paths, platform separators, user and host identity, permissions, inode/link counts, clocks, random temporary suffixes and filesystem ordering never enter canonical store records, bundle bytes, logical reports or result identity.

The returned RunAuditStoreResult is one closed immutable stored, existing, loaded, invalid, unsupported or io_error value with mathematical_authority false; persistence never upgrades a recorded mathematical verdict.
MemoryError, KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit propagate after closing descriptors and removing only the operation's own uncommitted temporary file where safely possible.

epistemics.authority: all store records and results have mathematical_authority false and cannot replace Evidence or Certificate authority
epistemics.dedupe: recognizes byte identity only and grants no semantic or cache authority
epistemics.invalid: corrupt, partial, missing, conflicting, linked, unsupported or over-budget state is not repaired or partially trusted
epistemics.load: returns only a freshly complete logical replay of exact committed bytes and does not trust filenames or recorded status alone
epistemics.persistence: proves only that exact bytes were durably committed under the supported filesystem contract, not that a mathematical claim is true

invariants: No operation accepts root itself, a relative path, parent traversal, lexical alias, symlink/reparse-point ancestor, or a root deeper than the fixed component budget.
Every visible store component is a real private directory or exact regular file; content and record files have one link, expected mode where supported, exact length and exact filename digest.
A content path never changes after first successful installation; an existing path is reused only after exact byte comparison and any difference is a conflict.
A run is visible only when its immutable record exists and every named object plus manifest and logical report is exact and freshly replays complete.
Temporary files are created only in the target directory with exclusive creation, private mode and bounded names; they are never listed as runs or trusted as content.
The run record object inventory is sorted unique and exactly matches the manifest's distinct physical bytes, including the logical report; omission, surplus or duplicate identity fails.
Same-run concurrency cannot create divergent bytes, different-run concurrency cannot share a mutable pointer, and directory enumeration order never changes canonical listing.
Unsupported fsync, permission, disk-full, rename, stat, read or write behavior is explicit and cannot return stored/existing/loaded success.
Public store result values are final, immutable, constructor-owned, non-pickle authority and freshly revalidated before serialization.
No path, inode, timestamp, permission, host, process or temporary observation appears in canonical bytes or changes mathematical classification.
raises: RunAuditStoreError is raised by strict load/list/serialization accessors and for unrecoverable caller path or exact-type misuse with a closed kind covering type, path, link, mode, io, budget, missing, conflict, corrupt, partial or unsupported.
PermissionError and TypeError protect direct construction, subclassing and pickling of public store values.
MemoryError, KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit propagate unchanged after bounded local cleanup.
requires: MH-C-WORKFLOW-001 governs this critical persistent content-addressed serialization boundary.
root is an exact pathlib.Path naming a non-root absolute normalized lexical path and bundle is an exact closed RunAuditBundle governed by accepted MH-C-AUDITED-RUN-002 and MH-C-RUN-AUDIT-REPLAY-002.

The implementation binds the exact accepted audit/replay contracts and schema identities run-audit-store-record-v2=614083f9de220b6a780ff35e7ab6cd3c07f1c3371255112e433213ea556ade8f, run-audit-store-result-v2=65b72c626dbca01f6da8c99650ece7e01231bb8caec290eac481f7f8c087e2ed.

The caller grants filesystem effects only beneath root; no path component, manifest field, object bytes, symlink target, environment value, clock, random token or external latest pointer may expand the authority boundary.
